err_open_key: Couldn’t read the saved API key
timeout: The gateway didn’t answer within {seconds} s
status_401: Authentication failed (401): the API key is wrong or expired, or this gateway wants another auth method
status_403: Forbidden (403): this key can’t use this model or endpoint
status_404: Not found (404): the Base URL may be wrong (it should be Anthropic Messages compatible)
status_429: Rate limited (429): try again later, or the quota is used up
models_unreadable: Couldn’t read the gateway’s model list
